title: Syracuse to bring additional license plate readers online with new vendor
summary: Syracuse Police Department received authorization to expand its license plate reader (LPR) network from an unspecified current deployment to a full 26-camera system through a new vendor partnership. This represents a capital procurement and IT infrastructure expansion for public safety surveillance capabilities.

political_signal.description: Authorization of expanded surveillance infrastructure signals police department's crime-reduction priority and municipal support for technology-driven public safety approaches.

processing_notes: Article lacks critical details: vendor name not provided, timeline not specified, budget/cost not disclosed, current camera count unclear
